ATTRIBUTION_GAP: What is stated only on Profiles: LeadingStressWeights.stress (NavierStokes/LeadingStressWeights.lean:23), stress_eq (:26), stress_eq_of_coordinates (:84), stress_outside (:98); ProfileSpectralCone.stressVector (NavierStokes/ProfileSpectralCone.lean:200), stressVector_eq_stocks (:205). The named stress is built from the (4.10)-primitive lags Profiles.angularLag / axialLag (NavierStokes/ProfileHistories.lean:585, :588); their identification with the paper's (4.16) form, angularLag_integrated (:591) and axialLag_integrated (:601), has the hypothesis p in D.carrier, so this route does not reach the paper's class.

What is stated axis-free, and gives the clause by combination: (1) Delta m = 0 on X >= X_h: NominalProfile.prefix_integral_propagate (NavierStokes/NominalProfile.lean:470) and moments_propagate (:486), for arbitrary fields, hypotheses IntegrableOn on Ioc 0 r only; rows at :240. (2) p_s for a bare pair: SeedHandbackJets.Profile (NavierStokes/SeedHandbackJets.lean:237), history (:249), curves (:252), outputs (:256), stocks (:90), and stocks_formulas (:94), which writes outputs 2 and 3 as X/L * Q_s and X/(L*E) * N_s in the values of the seven curves and their derivWithin on J = Icc (-1) 1 (packet, :25). Equal curves on J at a fixed X give equal outputs at every eta in J. (3) a and -b_s for arbitrary functions: ModulatedCone.angularShear (NavierStokes/ModulatedCone.lean:24), signedAxialShear (:28); agreement at every X >= X_h, endpoint included, by MatchingConeBounds.deriv_eqOn_Ici (NavierStokes/MatchingConeBounds.lean:551). (4) F = E/sqrt(2X) agrees pointwise by hypothesis. (5) Delta T_0 = 0 is then equality of two terms F*(outputs 2 - angularShear, outputs 3 - signedAxialShear), by rewriting; stressVector_eq_stocks (:205) shows this is the repository's own formula for its stress on a carrier. Not stated by any repository declaration, and used in step (1)-(2): the passage from the set integral over Ioc 0 X (NominalProfile.moments, :244) to the interval integral 0..X (Profile.history, :249), and congruence of derivWithin on J; both are Mathlib unfolding, not analytic facts.

The use at the manuscript's p. 40 site, as the Lean has it: NominalConeAssembly.Witness.log_fields (NavierStokes/NominalConeAssembly.lean:635), log_lags (:669), log_stocks (:701), log_shears (:718) equate U, E, the lags, p1/p2 and shearA/shearB of the joined axis-regular profile, for heatJoin < X and eta in [-1,1], with HeatSwitchCone.Qs (NavierStokes/HeatSwitchCone.lean:772), Ns (:780), radialA (:790), radialB (:792), stressScale (:1001), which are defined directly on the outgoing profile with no Profiles structure. LeadingStressWeights.nominal_terminal_stress (:321) rewrites stress_eq with these (:354) to get stress W.profiles = (TerminalHistoryBridge.forwardTheta, forwardAxial) (NavierStokes/TerminalHistoryBridge.lean:219, :225) on the terminal region. The p. 43-44 instance between two axis-regular profiles is stress_outside (:98), with strict inequalities.

CONFIRMED_CONTENT: SlowDivergence.radialFlux (NavierStokes/SlowDivergence.lean:21-24) has third term CoordinateAlgebra.d p.2 * SimilarityProfile.partialEta (average U) p, and partialEta f w = fderiv R f w (0,1) (NavierStokes/SimilarityProfile.lean:37), a plane derivative. NaturalCoefficientBridge.radialFlux_congr_germ (NavierStokes/NaturalCoefficientBridge.lean:280) asks for U =f[nhds w] V, a two-sided plane germ; AssembledSlowBase.local_flux_eq (NavierStokes/AssembledSlowBase.lean:776) asks for EqOn on Ico 0 r x S, a prefix. For the eta-partial itself the only congruences found are TransitionRamp.parameterPartial_congr (NavierStokes/TransitionRamp.lean:352), whose hypothesis is F p = G p at every p with p.2 in J, i.e. at all radii, and ReferenceUniformJets.parameterPartial_congr_on (NavierStokes/ReferenceUniformJets.lean:37), whose hypothesis is EqOn on the whole open RadialDomain carrier; the carrier reaches below X_h and down to the axis by RadialDomain.scale_mem (NavierStokes/ProfileHistories.lean:34). The one reduction of partialEta to a 1-D eta-derivative, ProfileHistories.parameterPartial_hasDerivAt (:60), also requires a RadialDomain carrier and ContDiffOn there, which the paper's class does not supply. The pointwise part is fine: average U at X_h is fixed by Delta M = 0 through ProfileHistories.average_eq_quotient (:297).

ATTRIBUTION_GAP: NominalProfile.moments_propagate (NavierStokes/NominalProfile.lean:486) gives all five rows of Delta m = 0 generically; SeedHandbackJets.stocks_formulas (NavierStokes/SeedHandbackJets.lean:94) makes Q_s, N_s, p_s functions of the seven curves alone; ActivationStocks.profiles_stocks_congr (NavierStokes/ActivationStocks.lean:833) and ModulatedExterior.pressure_equal_after (NavierStokes/ModulatedExterior.lean:61) give Delta p_s = 0 and Delta Pi = 0 in the Profiles layer. For the shears the layers are bridged: NominalConeAssembly.modulated_shears_eq (NavierStokes/NominalConeAssembly.lean:573) proves ModulatedCone.angularShear P.E = ActivationContinuation.shearA P and signedAxialShear P.E P.U = shearB P for every Profiles P. For p_s there is no such bridge: SeedHandbackJets.lean imports only ClosedIntervalJetAlgebra, NaturalAxisData and Mathlib, and no declaration was found equating its stocks with ReferenceBounds.p1, p2 (NavierStokes/ReferenceBounds.lean:39,45).

Part (ii) is stated faithfully and in full by profile_comparison_norm: the five integrals, the (4.16) formulas, p_s = (XQ_s/L, XN_s/(LE)), the max-component C^k eta-norm with one-sided derivatives at eta = +-1, and the exact list of what C may depend on all match, with no radial derivative of a difference. Part (i) is not stated as one declaration. V_0, a, b_s and the stocks are all available for arbitrary fields, so the tail hypothesis gives them for every X > X_h, and for a and b_s at X = X_h too, by deriv_eqOn_Ici. The T_0 clause is not stated for the paper's class, since the named stress (LeadingStressWeights.stress) takes an axis-regular Profiles argument and its lags are tied to (4.16) only on a carrier. But the paper defines T_0 by (4.11) as F(p_s - s) with the explicit (4.16) stocks, and F, p_s, a, b_s are each stated axis-free (SeedHandbackJets.stocks and stocks_formulas, ModulatedCone.angularShear and signedAxialShear), so Delta T_0 = 0 follows from the stated agreements by congruence; I read this derivation and did not compile it. The one application to a pair that is not regular at the axis (pp. 35, 40) needs only p_s, a and b_s, which the Lean states as Witness.log_stocks and log_shears. What is still missing is V_0 at the single radius X = X_h, whose partialEta (average U) term is a plane fderiv that no stated congruence pins down from tail agreement. Relation partial, verdict DELTA, now on the V_0 endpoint alone.

findings.summary: No declaration states Delta T_0 = 0, or names T_0 = F(p_s - s) with the (4.16) stocks, for pairs smooth only on (0,infinity) x [-1,1]; the repository's named stress takes a Profiles argument. The clause nevertheless follows from stated axis-free declarations by congruence alone (about six steps, read and not compiled), because the paper defines T_0 by (4.11) as a composite of F, p_s, a, b_s and each of those is stated for arbitrary fields.

At the single radius X = X_h, Delta V_0 = 0 is not delivered by any stated congruence: its third term is partialEta (average U), a 2-D fderiv, and the stated eta-partial congruences all demand agreement at radii below X_h. The shear clause, by contrast, is covered.

No declaration conjoins the clauses of part (i), and the two layers in which they live are joined for the shears but not for p_s: nothing identifies the axis-free SeedHandbackJets stocks with the Profiles-layer ReferenceBounds.p1, p2.
